#viewing imported data
#summary(nyarwungo)

#we will now focus on our data set hospital_patients 
#hospital_patients
#summary(hospital_patients)

# we will now chech for the mnissing values in our data set "hospital_patients"
colSums(is.na(hospital_patients))

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Remove 5 duplicate patient records using patient_id -> 500 unique patients
hospital_clean <- hospital_patients %>%
  distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# data cleaning, changing dates
hospital_clean <- hospital_clean %>%
  mutate(admission_date = as.Date(admission_date),
         discharge_date = as.Date(discharge_date))

str(hospital_clean)

# data visualization 
# 1. Histogram: distribution of one number
hist(hospital_clean$age, main = "Age of patients", xlab = "Age")

# 2. Bar plot: count of a category
barplot(table(hospital_clean$diagnosis), main = "Patients by diagnosis", las = 2)

# 3. Boxplot: a number split by a category
boxplot(age ~ sex, data = hospital_clean, main = "Age by sex")

# 4. Scatter plot: two numbers
plot(hospital_clean$height_cm, hospital_clean$weight_kg,
     main = "Height vs weight", xlab = "Height (cm)", ylab = "Weight (kg)")
```{r}
ggplot(hospital_clean, aes(x = age)) + geom_histogram()
```
ggplot(hospital_clean, aes(x = age)) + geom_density()

ggplot(hospital_clean, aes(x = sex, y = age)) + geom_violin()

ggplot(hospital_clean, aes(x = department, y = age)) + geom_jitter()

ggplot(hospital_clean, aes(x = age)) + geom_density() + geom_rug()

ggplot(hospital_clean, aes(x = age)) + geom_histogram() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(hospital_clean$age))
  
ggplot(hospital_clean, aes(x = sex, y = age)) + geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(hospital_clean$age))
  
hospital_clean$month <- as.numeric(format(hospital_clean$admission_date, "%m"))

monthly <- hospital_clean %>% count(month)

ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month, y = n)) + geom_line()

ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month, y = n, label = n)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.5)

# geom_point: one dot per patient
ggplot(hospital_clean, aes(x = height_cm, y = weight_kg)) + geom_point()

# geom_smooth: add a trend line on top of the points
ggplot(hospital_clean, aes(x = height_cm, y = weight_kg)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth()

```
